task.description:
Run the full test suite for the process definition module (PD-01 + PD-02). Execute the following commands and capture results:
1. `zig build test` — must exit 0
2. `zig build test-integration` — run against live database (requires BPM_TEST_DB_URL)

Write a test report to `tests/reports/WF02-pd01-20260521-run-01.md` in the standard format from the test guide §8.

For each test case in tests/specs/PD-01-02.md, record: PASS / FAIL / SKIP with any failure details.

If any tests fail due to implementation bugs (not environment issues), set result.status = FAIL and list issues with severity. ORCH will route to ISSUE-FIXER if needed.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test-integration exits 0 (all PD-01-02 test cases PASS)

result.summary: All PD-01 and PD-02 tests passed. zig build test: exit 0, 12/12 unit graph-validation tests PASS (38 integration stubs SKIP). zig build test-integration: exit 0, 34/34 tests PASS including all 15 PD integration test cases (TC-PD-01-01 through TC-PD-01-04, TC-PD-02-01 through TC-PD-02-11). No bugs found. No regressions in Stage 1 tests.
